Provides a resource to create a DTS sync job config

> **NOTE:** Only `Running` sync jobs can be configured.

import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const example = new tencentcloud.dts.SyncJobConfig("example", {
    jobId: "sync-6zm6nj70",
    dynamicOptions: {
        opTypes: [
            "Insert",
            "Update",
            "Delete",
            "PartialDDL",
        ],
        ddlOptions: [
            {
                ddlObject: "Database",
                ddlValues: [
                    "Create",
                    "Drop",
                    "Alter",
                ],
            },
            {

                ddlValues: [
                    "Alter",

                    "Rename",
                    "Truncate",
                ],
            },
            {
                ddlObject: "View",
                ddlValues: [
                    "Create",
                    "Drop",
                ],
            },
            {
                ddlObject: "Index",
                ddlValues: [
                    "Create",
                    "Drop",
                ],
            },
        ],
        kafkaOption: {
            dataOptions: [{
                key: "skipLargeMessage",
                value: "off",
            }],
        },
        conflictHandleType: "ReportError",
        dealOfExistSameTable: "ReportErrorAfterCheck",
    },
    dynamicObjects: {
        mode: "Partial",
        databases: [{
            dbName: "db1",
            dbMode: "All",
            tableMode: "All",
            viewMode: "All",
            procedureMode: "All",
            functionMode: "All",
        }],
        advancedObjects: [
            "procedure",
            "function",
        ],
    },
});

## Import



DTS sync job config can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Dts/syncJobConfig:SyncJobConfig example sync-6zm6nj70
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
